item.title: [Palimpsest availability] China censorship analysis: public finding unavailable
item.description: Palimpsest availability notice. No current cross-instrument finding is published because the active source policy does not allow the required public values. This is not a zero, normal, safe, unchanged, or directional reading. Publisher source reports remain available separately and are not treated as Palimpsest measurements. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/china-publication-rights-latest.json
